name: Athena Global Technologies Limited
summary: Athena Global Technologies Ltd. delivers a comprehensive suite of digital transformation services to enterprise clients, specializing in bespoke software application development and rigorous testing. Their expertise is deeply rooted in cutting-edge domains such as Artificial Intelligence, Blockchain Technology, Data Science, and the Internet of Things (IoT). Additionally, they excel in Robotics Process Automation (RPA), crafting conversational AI solutions like chatbots and voicebots, end-to-end product engineering, and advanced quality assurance practices. The company was co-founded by Jalagam Venkat Rao and Satyendra Manchala on May 6, 1992, and operates from its main office in Hyderabad, India.
